title: G7 Sensor Age uploaded to Nightscout can be wrong
body:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e25f528b-d872-45a4-b578-071616f5bac1) 

If you wait for your old sensor to expire, when you switch to the new sensor, the sensor age uploaded to Nightscout is very close to reality.
But, if you don't wait for your old sensor to expire before switching the transmitter ID to that of the new one, xDrip continues to upload the age of the old sensor.

xDrip reports the correct expected sensor expiry for G7 regardless.  So, this should be easy to fix by changing what xDrip updates to Nightscout for sensor age for a G7.
